title: AutoRSE: Evaluating LLM Agents as Recommendation Engineers for Self-Evolving Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.37228v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recommender Systems Engineer Agents (RSE-Agents), which use LLM-based agents to autonomously improve recommendation algorithms, are emerging as a promising paradigm. However, their capabilities and limitations remain poorly understood due to the lack of a unified, standardized evaluation framework and systematic trajectory-level analysis. To address this gap, we introduce AutoRSE, an evaluation framework spanning six representative industrial-grade recommendation tasks, and conduct a large-scale empirical study of three frontier LLMs across three widely used agent harnesses. Our results show that RSE-Agents consistently enhance the performance of backbones on five of the six tasks, with an average relative improvement of 16.1%, indicating that they can already autonomously improve recommendation performance. translated_title: AutoRSE：将大语言模型智能体评估为自演化推荐系统的推荐工程师
translated_abstract: 推荐系统工程智能体（RSE-Agents）利用基于大语言模型的智能体自主改进推荐算法，正在成为一种有前景的新范式。然而，由于缺乏统一、标准化的评估框架以及系统性的轨迹级分析，其能力与局限性仍然知之甚少。为填补这一空白，我们提出了AutoRSE——一个覆盖六项代表性工业级推荐任务的评估框架，并对三个前沿大语言模型在三种广泛使用的智能体框架上开展了大规模实证研究。结果表明，RSE-Agents在六项任务中的五项上持续提升了骨干模型的性能，平均相对提升达16.1%，表明它们已经能够自主改进推荐性能。然而，轨迹级分析也揭示，当前的RSE-Agents主要扮演的是工程优化者的角色，而非算法……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了AutoRSE评估框架，通过覆盖六项工业级推荐任务的大规模实证研究发现，基于LLM的推荐工程智能体能将推荐性能平均提升16.1%，但目前主要充当工程优化者而非算法创新者。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AutoRSE, an evaluation framework showing through large-scale empirical studies across six industrial recommendation tasks that LLM-based RSE-Agents can autonomously improve recommendation performance by an average of 16.1%, though they currently act mainly as engineering optimizers rather than algorithmic innovators.
